title: Nonlinear Shrinkage for Higher Moments Estimation in Large Portfolios
abstract: arXiv:2611.27274v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Portfolio risk is not limited to the variance of returns. The moments of portfolio returns depend directly on the covariance matrix and higher-order co-dependences (coskewness, cokurtosis, etc.). In practice, however, these objects are extremely noisy, especially for large portfolios. Here we introduce filtering methods based on tensor decompositions that extend cross-validated covariance cleaning and the Average Oracle methodology to even-order co-moment tensors. Using returns on historical Russell 1000 constituents, we find that the proposed filters improve out-of-sample estimation accuracy relative to sample estimators, both for correlation and cokurtosis tensors, as measured by relative squared Frobenius errors. These improvements translate into lower relative errors on portfolio volatility and kurtosis, and into lower out-of-sample volatility and kurtosis when the portfolio objective penalizes both variance and the fourth moment.

translated_title: 大型投资组合高阶矩估计的非线性收缩方法
translated_abstract: 投资组合的风险并不局限于收益率的方差。投资组合收益率的矩直接取决于协方差矩阵以及高阶相互依赖性（余偏度、余峰度等）。然而在实践中，这些对象极具噪声，尤其是对于大型投资组合而言。本文引入了基于张量分解的过滤方法，将交叉验证协方差清理和平均Oracle方法扩展到偶数阶共矩张量。使用历史Russell 1000成分股的收益率数据，我们发现相对于样本估计量，所提出的过滤器在相关张量和余峰度张量上都提高了样本外估计精度，这通过相对平方Frobenius误差来衡量。这些改进转化为投资组合波动率和峰度的更低相对误差，并且当投资组合目标函数同时惩罚方差和四阶矩时，还带来了更低的样本外波动率和峰度。
tldr: 本文提出基于张量分解的过滤方法，将协方差清理技术扩展至偶数阶共矩张量，显著提升了大型投资组合高阶矩的样本外估计精度，并在同时惩罚方差和四阶矩的投资组合优化中降低了样本外波动率和峰度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces tensor-decomposition-based filtering methods that extend covariance cleaning techniques to even-order co-moment tensors, improving out-of-sample estimation accuracy for higher moments in large portfolios and reducing out-of-sample volatility and kurtosis when the portfolio objective penalizes both variance and the fourth moment.
